response.overview: Delve into a mysterious filamentous jungle, where shape-shifting predators hunt other creatures, scavengers gather around a colossal husk to nibble, and partners entwine in romantic mating. Within this vibrant world teem peculiar forms of life, enacting dramas of birth, death, love, and predation. As a water droplet falls, its splash bursts into countless fragments—like stellar debris and cosmic dust. This unknown alien world, it turns out, emerges from the most primal and ordinary drop of pond water. Their universe is both microcosmic and macrocosmic; here, in the tiniest of places, we listen to their voices.
response.title: Water's Time Slice
